instruction: Count how many students fall into each mark range and place the counts in designated cells: 0-25 marks in D31, 26-50 marks in D32, 51-75 marks in D33, and 76-100 marks in D34.

metadata.explanation: Task requires counting students in 4 mark ranges. Verified with Python: 0-25: 8 students (Benedict 9, Blake 25, Arnold 10, John 1, Kanye 3, Emma 1, Selena 18, Ellen 11), 26-50: 5 students (Olivia 43, Jeff 38, Keira 40, Demi 46, Jim 34), 51-75: 8 students (Bey 54, Parah 57, Elijah 56, 50 Dollar 54, Jonah 65, Lady 74, Angelina 67, Roger 74), 76-100: 3 students (Reese 95, Swan 89, Morgan 76). Total 24 numeric marks.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: 0.25 per correct count. Full 1.0 if all 4 range counts are correct.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 4 instruction requirements: counts for mark ranges 0-25 (D31), 26-50 (D32), 51-75 (D33), and 76-100 (D34)
